title: ConversationPatch
description: Typed session patch against ConversationState. Backend owns platform fields and current values; model must not supply old_value.

path.description: JSON Pointer under allowlisted families, e.g. /active_need/budget/value

evidence_text.description: Optional evidence; stored as hash reference only, never required in Redis payload

need_profile.description: Optional typed seed for RESET_NEED (need_id assigned by backend; no platform/category fields)
